blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Bicol Saro party-list Rep. Terry Ridon has called out members of the Duterte family for the cyber libel cases filed against members of the media, saying that if they were able to do it before, lawmakers will not allow it to happen again. In an interview on Monday at the Batasang Pambansa complex, Ridon said that the House prosecution team is bothered about the cases filed against broadcast network GMA-7 and veteran journalist Philip Lustre Jr. “Sa araw po na ito, nagpapahayag ng pagkabahala ang House prosecution panel, doon po sa mga serye ng mga kasong isinampa laban […]...
